units.source_text: 迄今我不曾见过这样一张充满强烈的拒绝感的脸。

en.t: Until now, I had never seen a face so filled with an intense sense of refusal.

units.source_text: 我认为自己的脸是被世界拒绝的脸，可是有为子的脸却是拒绝世界的脸。

en.t: I thought of my own face as one rejected by the world, but Uiko's face was one that rejected the world.

units.source_text: 月光无情地流泻在她的额头、眼睛，鼻梁和脸颊上，可是这张坚定的脸只是被月光荡涤着。

en.t: Moonlight poured mercilessly over her forehead, eyes, bridge of the nose, and cheeks, yet that resolute face was only being washed by the moonlight.

units.source_text: 她只要稍微动一动眼睛，稍微动一动嘴巴，

en.t: If she merely moved her eyes a little, merely moved her mouth a little,

units.source_text: 她企图拒绝的世界就会以此为信号，从这里迅速崩溃的吧。

en.t: the world she was trying to reject would surely take that as its signal and swiftly collapse from this very point.
